last.verdict: Sales beat, but profit missed and the Apogee deal trimmed the yearly outlook.

reasons.label: Profit missed estimates
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $3.65 fell short of the roughly $3.71 analysts expected.

reasons.label: Profit outlook trimmed
reasons.text: 2026 EPS guidance cut to $13.87–$14.07, below the $14.12 consensus, on Apogee deal costs.

reasons.label: $10.9B Apogee deal
reasons.text: AbbVie agreed to buy Apogee for about $10.9 billion, adding $0.14 per share of dilution.

story: Quarterly sales have kept growing about 10%, led by Skyrizi and Rinvoq. Earnings guidance has been trimmed by deal and drug-research charges. The stock rose about 2.5% after the April report, but fell about 6.5% in February and about 3% now.
